hooks.text: Kabhi dhyan diya hai, Google Maps sirf 60 results dikhata hai…
Subah se shaam local business dhoondhte dhoondhte nikal jati hai?
Bohot kam log local business leads ye kar rahe hain…
Kaash mujhe local business dhoondhne ka ye tareeka pehle pata hota…
Manual lead generation aapka sabse zyada time khata hai…
Har search mein wahi business dikhte hain kyunki kuch save nahi hota hai.

master_script.linkedin_english: If you are a freelancer or agency selling to local businesses, finding leads on Google Maps takes hours and shows the same results again. LocalSignal sends you a daily Excel sheet of pre-qualified local businesses with website details, so you can pitch instead of searching. Comment LEADS and I will send you a checklist for picking businesses to contact and what to say.

marketing.gets: a one-page checklist: how to pick the 20 local businesses worth contacting first and what to say in the first message

facts.claim: Manual research on maps and search is free and uncovers many local businesses, especially those that appear on Google Maps but have no website.
facts.title: How to Find Leads in India: Methods Compared LeadsMint

facts.claim: The downside of manual map research is the time it takes, because nothing is recorded and repeated searches return the same businesses.
facts.title: How to Find Leads in India: Methods Compared LeadsMint

facts.claim: Lead‑finder software such as LeadsMint lets you search for a business type within a radius of 1 to 50 km, review results for free, unlock leads for a credit, and manage them in a CRM, but it only shows businesses listed on Google Maps.
facts.title: How to Find Leads in India: Methods Compared LeadsMint

facts.claim: A single Google Maps search returns a limited set of results, currently up to 60 per query.
facts.title: How to Find Leads in India: Methods Compared LeadsMint

facts.claim: Google Maps and other map listings give you the name, phone, address, rating and website (if any) of local businesses, but each lead must be captured manually.
facts.title: How to Get Leads Without Buying Lists or Spending Money

facts.claim: LinkedIn’s free search can reveal decision‑maker names and titles, although the free version imposes usage limits.
facts.title: How to Get Leads Without Buying Lists or Spending Money

facts.claim: BrightLocal reported that 84 % of consumers searched for a local business in the past three months, and 73 % started their most recent local search on a mobile device.
facts.title: How to Find Leads for Local Businesses: The Signal Playbook - CapyScout Blog

facts.claim: BrightLocal also found that 75 % of consumers decide which local business to use within 30 minutes, and 72 % consider three or fewer options.
facts.title: How to Find Leads for Local Businesses: The Signal Playbook - CapyScout Blog

master_script.topic: The myth that manual research is the only way to find 'high-quality' local leads.
notes: style remark (not blocking): lines are bare statements; use helping words that give the reason or an example (kyunki, isliye, matlab, jaise ki, phir, taaki) so the viewer understands WHY
